ICSB
I (Image Type): pitch-deck style flowchart / loop diagram (16:9), designed for blog readability
C (Content): a 5-step loop with large numbered nodes and short English labels:
1) "Make 3 Variants" (A/B/C thumbnails)
2) "Publish"
3) "Watch Metrics" (Impressions / CTR / First-30s Retention)
4) "Change ONE Variable" (face OR text OR main subject)
5) "Log & Pick Winner"
Use arrows forming a loop from 5 back to 1.
Include a small side note box (English): "Don't change title + thumbnail at the same time".
